tasks.title: Motor failure mask
tasks.solution: SIM_ENGINE_FAIL is a bitmask: bit 0 is motor (output) 1, bit k − 1 is motor k. Mask = 2^(a−1) + 2^(b−1). The module's example: motor 3 → 4, motor 1 → 1.

tasks.title: How many update() calls it takes
tasks.solution: Per call, no more than floor(5000 / k) elements (half of the 10000 instructions is a course guideline, leaving room for the rest of the call's code). Calls = ceil(n / floor(5000 / k)). Exceeding 10000 gives exceeded time limit, and the script is removed.
